purpose: Show an animated horizontal ranking chart over time without parent-group classification.

rawDataContract.notes: Use one row per item per frame. Each row must contain a frame, an item name, and a numeric value.

displayMode.behavior: Do not show a legend. Assign each ranked item a stable color from the chart palette, and keep that item's color consistent across all frames.

semanticChannels.payloadField: encode.name or encode.category; legacy encode.series when no name/category is supplied

modelInstructions: Use one row per category per frame.
Do not generate encode.group, encode.color, or a parent classification field.
Assign different items different colors from the palette.
Keep each item's color stable across all frames.
Keep the number of visible categories readable with topN.
